misc.text: You mother fuckers dissed the Nintendo Switch for years for having games run at 30 frames. Don't start switching up now :) DriftRespawn (@playb0y4L) People are seriously overreacting about GTA 6 potentially running at 30 FPS. GTA V and RDR2 both ran at 30 FPS and were still incredible experiences. As long as GTA 6 delivers a stable, consistent 30 FPS, I honestly think it’ll be fine. 30 FPS isn’t nearly as bad as people make it out to be.
